mapper.select: SELECT input_hash,user_id,bootstrap FROM pf.identity_operation WHERE request_id=#{request}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pf.identity_operation WHERE bootstrap)
SELECT id,username_norm AS username,password_hash,status='ACTIVE' AS active,platform_admin FROM pf.app_user WHERE username_norm=#{name}
SELECT id,username_norm AS username,password_hash,status='ACTIVE' AS active,platform_admin FROM pf.app_user WHERE id=#{id} AND status='ACTIVE'

SELECT s.id,s.type,m.role,st.object_limit_bytes FROM pf.space s JOIN pf.membership m ON m.space_id=s.id JOIN pf.space_storage st ON st.space_id=s.id JOIN pf.app_user u ON u.id=m.user_id WHERE u.id=#{user} AND u.status='ACTIVE' AND m.status='ACTIVE' AND (s.type<>'PERSONAL' OR s.owner_user_id=u.id) ORDER BY s.id

SELECT a.token_hash,a.csrf_hash,a.user_id,a.created_at,a.last_seen_at,a.expires_at FROM pf.auth_session a LEFT JOIN pf.app_user u ON u.id=a.user_id WHERE token_hash=#{token} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>#{now} AND last_seen_at>#{idle} AND (a.user_id IS NULL OR u.status='ACTIVE') FOR UPDATE OF a
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.auth_session SET last_seen_at=#{now} WHERE token_hash=#{token}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM pf.auth_session WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM pf.auth_session WHERE expires_at<=#{now} OR revoked_at<=#{retention} LIMIT 100)
DELETE FROM pf.auth_rate WHERE bucket IN (SELECT bucket FROM pf.auth_rate WHERE window_start<#{retention} AND (locked_until IS NULL OR locked_until<#{now}) LIMIT 100)
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.auth_session SET csrf_hash=#{csrf} WHERE token_hash=#{token} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: UPDATE pf.auth_session SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE token_hash=#{token} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at>#{now} AND last_seen_at>#{idle} RETURNING id
mapper.update: UPDATE pf.auth_session SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE token_hash=#{token}
UPDATE pf.auth_session SET revoked_at=#{now} WHERE user_id=#{id} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: INSERT INTO pf.auth_rate(bucket,window_start,attempts) VALUES(#{key},#{now},1) ON CONFLICT(bucket) DO UPDATE SET attempts=CASE WHEN pf.auth_rate.window_start<=#{boundary} THEN 1 ELSE pf.auth_rate.attempts+1 END,window_start=CASE WHEN pf.auth_rate.window_start<=#{boundary} THEN EXCLUDED.window_start ELSE pf.auth_rate.window_start END RETURNING attempts
SELECT window_start,attempts,locked_until FROM pf.auth_rate WHERE bucket=#{key}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pf.auth_rate(bucket,window_start) VALUES(#{key},#{now}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT window_start,attempts,locked_until FROM pf.auth_rate WHERE bucket=#{key} FOR UPDATE

SELECT to_regclass('pf.app_user') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.space') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.membership') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.auth_session') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.identity_operation') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.auth_rate') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('pf.space_storage') IS NOT NULL AND (SELECT schema_version=1 FROM pf.baseline_version WHERE id=1)
